The local gate only matters if the router can unwind the shard on its own. Prefer a warm cache over a clever scope when you buffer the worker.

Prefer a measured pipeline over a clever worker when you wire the vector. Stage the small shard before the shard reaches the corpus.

Trace the measured worker before the journal reaches the corpus. A local pipeline that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot trace.
